### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Guard rails for verifying code inside a secondary checkout (git worktree, extra clone) and for parallelizing implementation agents across them — an editable-installed package silently imports the primary checkout, so a green suite may have tested the wrong code. Use before running tests in a worktree, spawning parallel worktree workers, or attributing a worktree-only test failure.
